verdict.rationale: Claude Code has an explicit Skills feature letting developers package repeatable workflows as custom slash-command-like skills (e.g. /review-pr, /deploy-staging) that teams can share, alongside MCP for connecting external tools and hooks for custom automation. This is documented first-party with concrete examples, though independent hands-on validation specifically of the skills feature is thin. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of skills usage, deeper documentation on skill creation syntax/limitations.
